title: Employer-Liable Shortfall History and the Reinstated-Schedule Late Charge Rate
content:
Employer-liable shortfalls add to the late charge rate on a deduction schedule a returned remittance reinstated, under the Paystride Earned Wage Access Program Agreement: where at least 3 employer-liable shortfall notices were booked on entry dates from which fewer than 12 whole months have passed to today, 0.25 percentage points are added; where exactly 2 were, 0.15 percentage points are added; otherwise none.

A whole month from an entry date is reached on the same day of the month as that entry date, or on the first day of the next month where that month has no such day. Provider-absorbed shortfall notices are not counted.

| Employer-liable shortfall notices in the window | Points added |
|---|---|
| 3 or more | 0.25 |
| exactly 2 | 0.15 |
| 0 or 1 | none |
